core_correction: The fixed-root finite/convolution/normalizer chain is already uniform over every root that passes the complete gate set: its numerical inputs are the gate floor 64 and root-independent constants, not the actual pivots. The six receipts are witnesses of a nonempty gate set, not the domain of the theorem.
gate_mass_note: The guard converts distributional uniformity into an accept-set/gate-mass question. It does not bound the gate-mass probabilities; those are operational abort masses, not cryptographic bounds.
guard_construction: SourceSchurBackend runs SchurNumericalAudit, the finite-chain source gates, the issuance C gate and the finite-key object/service envelope at Setup, and the Schur/audit gates before signing. Setup treats a gate failure as a root rejection/retry; signing treats it as a fixed-key abort. The original backend runs none of these execute-time gates.
